name: Overlay
lead: A canvas on one player's screen, from `player.ui.overlay`: 128 by 128, drawn like a canvas. Row 0 is the engine's and never shows; draw in rows 1 to 127. Colour `colors.transparent` shows the game through it.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Takes it off the player's screen.

fields.name: open
fields.description: True until `destroy` or the player leaves.
